initial_scene.description: Humanoid stands at a table facing the open black soft bag. A blue cube sits immediately to the bag’s right in the image, between bag and robot. Near-side arm hangs forward and down; far-side arm begins closer to the body.

anatomical_side_evidence.evidence: The blue facial edge faces toward image left and the exposed back support lies behind the body toward image right. This side view shows the near-side shoulder and arm on the robot’s left. The manipulating hand is attached to the opposite, far-side shoulder, hence robot-relative right; it is not labeled from image left/right. Near left shoulder/upper arm and far right forearm attachment can be followed in initial PNG and native frames 64, 174 and 200.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole manipulating hand; approaches cube, closes around it, lifts it, carries it above bag opening, lowers and releases it inside, then withdraws empty.
arm_hand_roles.left: Remains low in front of the body without touching cube or bag.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand manipulation; no hand-to-hand transfer, bag stabilization, or person interaction.

observed_sequence.observation: Robot faces table; blue cube remains on table beside open bag. Both hands initially away from object.
Far-side right arm rises and reaches toward cube, fingers open over the cube while near left arm remains low.
Right hand settles around blue cube and closes; cube is initially still against tabletop, then starts lifting near the interval end.
Right hand lifts cube clear of table and carries it toward the bag opening; cube visibly held beneath fingers.
Right hand lowers cube over and into the dark opening at the bag’s top; blue cube is partially visible at rim during lowering.
Blue cube disappears below bag rim while right fingers open and rise; native 244/258 show empty fingers over the opening. Bag remains on table.
Right hand lifts clear of bag and retracts toward body, visibly empty.
Robot settles with manipulating arm back and near left arm still low. Cube no longer visible on tabletop or in hand; bag remains upright.

terminal_state.description: Cube released below the open bag’s rim; right hand withdrawn empty. Bag remains upright on table, with cube concealed inside.
terminal_state.object_resting_position_visibility: Interior floor and final cube orientation occluded by opaque bag.

uncertainties: Opaque bag hides the cube’s final resting orientation and exact position inside. Anatomical labeling follows facing direction and near/far shoulder attachment rather than image coordinates; partial torso occlusion limits a completely frontal confirmation.
annotation_verification: Source describes grasping a cube and placing it inside a bag; full sequence supports this, including empty-hand withdrawal following disappearance below bag rim. Source has no hand-side annotation; right-hand role added from visual anatomy.
